## About
Anber Aziz is a world-class frontend architect and backend systems engineer specializing in autonomous multi-agent systems, hyper-scalable React/Next.js architectures, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and cloud deployment. Based in Lahore, Pakistan, offering enterprise-grade engineering services globally.

## Services
- AI & Machine Learning Engineering: Custom RAG pipelines, Agentic AI, LLM Guardrails, Computer Vision.
- Full-Stack Web Development: Next.js, React, Node.js, modern UI/UX, Brutalist design, high-converting interfaces.
- Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment: Edge computing, Cloudflare, serverless architectures, robust API design.
- Technical Consulting: Architecture reviews, system design, performance optimization.

## Mission
To build intelligent, scalable, and beautiful web experiences that solve impossible problems.
